Eli (People Ops): Quick check — finalizing panel for candidate Ava Chen (SWE IC). Interview Tue 2026-05-12 10:00 PT. Can folks confirm availability + who will lead debrief? Also need rubric clarification: do we lock architecture at 40% or 50% weight? Need to finalize before invites. Thanks!

Maya K.: Free — I can do system design (arch). 40% sounds right to me.

Jordan R.: I'm good for that slot, prefer to cover behavioral / cross-team questions. 40/30/30? (arch/impl/behavior)

Samir P.: I can cover implementation + code review. 50/30/20 works if team wants stronger signal on implementation.

Alex L. (Hiring Manager): Can we try 45/35/20? Also someone should own debrief — I can if needed but would prefer Maya to lead.

Maya K.: Happy to lead debrief if Alex runs the intro. @Eli will you send calendar + debrief doc link? :+1:

Eli (People Ops): Yep — I'll create the event and set a 15m debrief immediately after. Drafting the debrief doc now (placeholder): https://redwood.company/sheets/ops/debriefs/ava-chen — will include fields: score (1-5), strengths, concerns, hire? and culture fit notes.

RecruiterBot: Calendar event created and invites sent to panel. Room: Zoom — Redwood standard interview room (link attached in invite).

Jordan R.: Quick rubric q — do we use absolute 1-5 or relative to an internal bench? I used relative last hire and Mgmt asked for absolute.

Alex L. (Hiring Manager): Use absolute 1-5. We'll add short guidance in the doc: 4+ = strong hire, 3 = consider with reservations, 1-2 = not recommended.

Samir P.: Also — can we reserve an extra 10m for code walkthrough? If that's not possible, candidate can do the walkthrough during the main slot and we shorten Qs.

Eli (People Ops): Good call. I'll add a 10m buffer and extend to 1h10, with 15m debrief after. Updating invite now.

Maya K.: All set on my calendar. Who will post the debrief summary to #hiring once done?

Alex L. (Hiring Manager): I'll post the summary + recommended next step within 24h after debrief.

Jordan R.: I'll upload my score and quick notes to the doc before debrief.

Eli (People Ops): Thanks everyone — if anything changes, ping me here. :wave:
